title: A marker class is not the complete visual rendering contract
trigger: A component reimplements an existing styled element and tests only its base marker selector, while CSS depends on modifier classes or required child elements.
principle: Reusing a base DOM marker does not reproduce a visual component. Mirror every CSS-driving modifier class and required child node, then assert that semantic structure in regression tests; otherwise DOM tests can pass while the UI remains visually plain.

cases.context: A subtitle cue emitted .js-cell-token[data-cell-term], so the E2E selector passed, but omitted word/status/frequency classes and inner/status children required by token CSS.
